advice.title: Before you start
advice.body: Find a quiet spot, free of background noise. Speak clearly, 20–30 cm from the microphone.

gliederung.intro: Cover each of these points during your presentation — they count toward your grade.

betreuerObservation.body: Structure your monologue in three parts: an introduction, a development with a concrete example, then a conclusion.

micCheck.title: Test mic and speaker
micCheck.intro: 5 seconds of recording, then playback to make sure everything works.

audioReplay.unavailable: Audio playback isn't available in this version.

blockedReason.transcript_too_short: The passage is too short to assess.

legacy.title: Feedback from an earlier version
legacy.body: This submission was graded with an earlier version of the Betreuer. Redo the exercise to get the full feedback.

asr.unreliableNote: Some passages of the transcript are uncertain — the assessment relies on the clear ones.

inFlightFallback.title: Grading in progress
inFlightFallback.body: Heading you back to home. A small strip there will let you know the moment your feedback is ready.

poll_exhausted.title: We'll let you know when it's ready
poll_exhausted.body: Grading is taking a bit longer than expected. You can close the app — we'll send you a notification when it's done.

failed.title: The feedback couldn't be produced.
failed.body: Redo the exercise — nothing is lost.

languageNotGerman.title: Please record in German.
languageNotGerman.body: We only grade recordings in German. Redo the exercise speaking German to receive your grade.

tooShort.title: Please record a longer take.
tooShort.body: We only assess recordings long enough to give reliable feedback. Try again with a longer take (at least 10 seconds of speech).

generic.title: This recording couldn't be assessed.
generic.body: We couldn't produce feedback for this recording. Redo the exercise — none of your effort is lost.
